title: A Phase 3, Vehicle-controlled Efficacy and Safety Study of IDP-123 Lotion in the Treatment of Acne Vulgaris (302)
brief_summary: This is a multi-center, randomized, double-blind, vehicle-controlled, 12-week study designed to assess the safety, efficacy, and tolerability of IDP-123 Lotion in comparison with IDP-123 Vehicle Lotion.
